expected.pass_criteria: 当前SHA全部适用层实际执行；每候选有范围/分母/失败/区间，不用历史load CI替代。

OFFLINE.network: Loopback fixtures only; no default public server
OFFLINE.pass_criteria: Every mandatory normal/boundary/fault expectation matches; no unclassified failure or mandatory skip

POSTGRES.database: Fresh loopback PostgreSQL 18 instance and explicitly disposable database; never reuse a production connection
POSTGRES.pass_criteria: Real migrations, settlement, ledger, holds, route and recovery tests pass with zero environment skips

EXPERIMENT.pair_unit: seed x class x preregistered legal scenario; default-off and candidate-on share inputs and observation budget
EXPERIMENT.multiplicity: Holm correction across declared primary candidate comparisons; exploratory metrics labelled exploratory
EXPERIMENT.primary_metrics: B05=PVE duration/tail; B06=draw resource and idle time; B07=overflow recovery and capped resources; B08=control and action denial; B09=deck cycle dilution; exact per-task observable contract remains mandatory
EXPERIMENT.candidate_decision: Benefit requires paired 95% interval strictly on the beneficial side of zero, no correctness/rule regression and non-worsening risk interval; insufficient precision or censoring is Inconclusive
EXPERIMENT.pass_criteria: Resolver/CombatDeck/room-policy traces deterministic for fixed manifest; legal actions, equal information and budgets; all censoring and full denominators retained

RENDER.human_strata: Each class x novice/experienced; three games per anonymous participant
RENDER.pass_criteria: Actual visible interactions and screenshots plus logs show no blocked core action, stale overlay or clipped critical text; missing humans remains Partial

AUDIT.scope: Original authorized historical files and owned disposable local account ledger; global historical production mismatch remains unresolved without source evidence
AUDIT.pass_criteria: Each source file classified present/matching/missing; original raw never modified; asset/ledger/hold invariants reconstructed with explicit bounded account/time scope

actual.inputs: B02-B11必测、真实PG、多局/资源/控制/顺序

rollback: 候选切回原策略/原配置；已创建房间沿锁定策略完成；不逆向发放资产或退款。

missing_reasons.effective_room_policy: No runtime started at S0; default policy source is pinned in source manifest.
missing_reasons.runtime_image_digest: Local process profile; container image is not selected. Assemblies are hashed after build.
missing_reasons.sample_population: S0 registers budgets; no runtime sample has been observed.
missing_reasons.cutoff_monotonic: No runtime cutoff exists before execution.
missing_reasons.window_or_drain_or_final: No runtime window exists before execution.
missing_reasons.asset_and_route_postconditions: Measured at S4/S5, never inferred from source.
